# Richard Feng Creative

Richard Feng Creative is a Houston-based AI video advertising studio led by Richard Feng, also known as 小疯未眠 and Mr.Feng No Sleep.

## Core service

- AI commercial video production
- Short-form video advertising
- Creative direction and scripting
- AI visual production and editing
- Vertical social video for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and Xiaohongshu
- Houston-based service with remote projects available across the United States

## Industries represented in the portfolio

- Real estate
- Legal services
- Insurance
- Medical aesthetics and med spas
- Dental practices
- Local and professional service businesses
